entities.name: Izoni
entities.description: An elven champion of the Golgari Swarm on Ravnica who controls insects and spiders and is de facto guildmaster representative of the Golgari.

entities.name: Golgari Swarm
entities.description: A Ravnican guild whose ranks were decimated by the Phyrexians.

entities.name: Ravnica
entities.description: The guild-ruled city plane where Izoni lives.

entities.name: Devkarin
entities.description: A Golgari elven faction led by a Matka.

entities.name: Zdenia
entities.description: Izoni's predecessor as Matka of the Devkarin, who died suspiciously.

entities.name: Vraska
entities.description: A planeswalker and Golgari guildmaster who reclaimed leadership during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Kaya
entities.description: A planeswalker whose group met with the Golgari during the War of the Spark.

entities.name: Myczil Savod Zunich
entities.description: A Devkarin huntmaster tricked by Vraska into believing Izoni tried to kill him.

entities.name: Cevraya
entities.description: A Devkarin shaman tricked by Vraska about Izoni.

entities.name: Teysa Karlov
entities.description: Host of a party the year after the Invasion at which Zegana was murdered.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: A victim of the murder at Teysa Karlov's party.

entities.name: Alquist Proft
entities.description: A detective investigating the murders who visited Izoni for analysis of a chemical.

entities.name: Trostani
entities.description: Organizer of the murders in retribution for those she considered traitors during the Invasion.

entities.name: Oba
entities.description: Attacker of the guild leaders at Vitu-Ghazi.

entities.name: Vitu-Ghazi
entities.description: Location where Proft revealed the truth of the murders to the guild leaders.

entities.name: War of the Spark
entities.description: The war during which Vraska reclaimed Golgari leadership.

entities.name: New Phyrexian Invasion
entities.description: An invasion that killed many Golgari and shifted the undercity.

events.summary: Izoni becomes Matka of the Devkarin after the suspicious death of her predecessor Zdenia.
events.quote: Izoni became Matka of the Devkarin after the suspicious death of her predecessor

events.summary: During the War of the Spark, Vraska arrives at a Golgari meeting with Kaya's group and reclaims leadership; Izoni is the most begrudging to accept her.
events.quote: Izoni was the most begrudging to accept her authority

events.summary: Vraska tricks Myczil and Cevraya into thinking Izoni tried to poison Myczil with spiders, and they accept Vraska's protection.
events.quote: Both Myzcil and Cevraya consequently accepted the protection of Vraska.

events.summary: After the New Phyrexian Invasion, Izoni is first to denounce Vraska as guildmaster and the guild's factions follow.
events.quote: Izoni was the first to denounce Vraska as guildmaster

events.summary: Izoni skips Teysa Karlov's party and monitors the investigation with her spiders.
events.quote: She used her spiders to monitor the investigation as it progressed

events.summary: Alquist Proft visits Izoni, who concludes a chemical came from a living thing not native to Ravnica; Proft is knocked out by an unseen force.
events.quote: She concluded that it was derived from a living thing, but not something that was native to Ravnica.

events.summary: At Vitu-Ghazi, Proft reveals Trostani organized the murders in retribution for traitors during the Invasion; when Oba attacks the guild leaders, Izoni fights back.
events.quote: Izoni fought back instead of running away.

relations.quote: Izoni is an elven champion of the Golgari Swarm
Izoni became Matka of the Devkarin
Izoni was the first to denounce Vraska as guildmaster

relations.note: organized the murders in retribution for perceived traitors
relations.quote: Trostani had organized them in retribution
